xna-type.name: GraphicsDeviceCapabilities
xna-type.summary: Represents the capabilities of the hardware.

property.name: AdapterOrdinalInGroup
property.summary: Gets the number indicating the order in which heads are referenced by the API.
property.remarks: The value for the master adapter is always 0. These values do not correspond to the adapter ordinals. They apply only to heads within a group.

property.name: AlphaCompareCapabilities
property.summary: Gets the alpha-test comparison capabilities.

property.name: CubeTextureFilterCapabilities
property.summary: Gets texture-filtering capabilities for a cube texture.
property.remarks: Per-stage filtering capabilities reflect which filtering modes are supported for texture stages when performing multiple-texture blending. This member can be any combination of the per-stage texture-filtering flags defined in GraphicsDeviceCapabilities.FilterCaps .

property.name: CursorCapabilities
property.summary: Gets hardware cursor capabilties.

property.name: DeclarationTypeCapabilities
property.summary: Gets vertex data type capabilities.

property.name: DepthBufferCompareCapabilities
property.summary: Gets depth buffer comparision capabilities.

property.name: DestinationBlendCapabilities
property.summary: Gets destination-blending capabilities.

property.name: DeviceCapabilities
property.summary: Gets graphics device capabilities.

property.name: DeviceType
property.summary: Returns the type of the current GraphicsDevice.

property.name: DriverCapabilities
property.summary: Gets device driver capabilities.

property.name: ExtentsAdjust
property.summary: Gets the number of pixels to adjust the extents rectangle outward to accommodate antialiasing kernels.

property.name: GuardBandBottom
property.summary: Gets the bottom screen-space coordinate of the guard-band clipping region.

property.name: GuardBandLeft
property.summary: Gets the left screen-space coordinate of the guard-band clipping region.

property.name: GuardBandRight
property.summary: Gets the right coordinate of the guard-band clipping region.

property.name: GuardBandTop
property.summary: Gets the top screen-space coordinate of the guard-band clipping region.

property.name: LineCapabilities
property.summary: Gets line-drawing primitives capabilities.

property.name: MasterAdapterOrdinal
property.summary: Gets the master device for this subordinate.
property.remarks: For multi-head support, one head will be denoted the master head, and all other heads on the same card will be denoted subordinate heads. If more than one multi-head adapter is present in a system, the master and its subordinates from one multi-head adapter are called a group.

property.name: MaxAnisotropy
property.summary: Gets the maximum valid value for the MaxAnisotropy texture-stage state.

property.name: MaxPixelShader30InstructionSlots
property.summary: Gets the maximum number of pixel shader instruction slots supported.
property.remarks: The maximum value that can be set on this capability is 32,768. Devices that support ps_3_0 are required to support at least 512 instruction slots.

property.name: MaxPixelShaderProfile
property.summary: Returns the maximum pixel shader profile for this GraphicsDevice.

property.name: MaxPointSize
property.summary: Gets the maximum size of a point primitive.
property.remarks: If the size is set to 1.0f, the device does not support point size control.

property.name: MaxPrimitiveCount
property.summary: Gets the maximum number of primitives for each DrawPrimitives call.

property.name: MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets
property.summary: Gets the maximum number of simultaneous render targets.

property.name: MaxSimultaneousTextures
property.summary: Gets the maximum number of textures that can be simultaneously bound to the fixed-function pipeline sampler stages.
property.remarks: If the same texture is bound to two sampler stages, it counts as two textures. This value has no meaning in the programmable pipeline where the number of sampler stages is determined by each pixel shader version. Each pixel shader version also determines the number of texture declaration instructions.

property.name: MaxStreamStride
property.summary: Gets the maximum stride.

property.name: MaxStreams
property.summary: Gets the maximum number of concurrent data streams.
property.remarks: If this value is 0, then the driver is not a Direct3D 9 driver.

property.name: MaxTextureAspectRatio
property.summary: Gets the maximum texture aspect ratio supported by the hardware.

property.name: MaxTextureHeight
property.summary: Gets the maximum texture height for this device.

property.name: MaxTextureRepeat
property.summary: Gets the maximum range of the integer bits of the post-normalized texture coordinates.
property.remarks: A texture coordinate is stored as a 32-bit signed integer using 27 bits to store the integer part and 5 bits for the floating-point fraction. The maximum integer index, 227, is used to determine the maximum texture coordinate, depending on how the hardware does texture-coordinate scaling. Some hardware reports the cap TextureCaps.SupportsTextureRepeatNotScaledBySize . For this case, the device defers scaling texture coordinates by the texture size until after interpolation and application of the texture address mode, so the number of times a texture can be wrapped is given by the integer value in MaxTextureRepeat . Less desirably, on some hardware TextureCaps.SupportsTextureRepeatNotScaledBySize is not set and the device scales the texture coordinates by the texture size (using the highest level of detail) prior to interpolation. This limits the number of times a texture can be wrapped to MaxTextureRepeat / texture size. For example, assume that MaxTextureRepeat is equal to 32K and the size of the texture is 4K. If the hardware sets TextureCaps.SupportsTextureRepeatNotScaledBySize , then the number of times a texture can be wrapped is equal to MaxTextureRepeat (32K, in this example). Otherwise, the number of times a texture can be wrapped is equal to MaxTextureRepeat divided by texture size, which, in this example, is 32K/4K, or 8.

property.name: MaxTextureWidth
property.summary: Gets the maximum texture width for this device.

property.name: MaxUserClipPlanes
property.summary: Gets the maximum number of user-defined clipping planes supported.
property.remarks: For a given physical device, this capability might vary across Direct3D devices, depending on the parameters supplied to the Device constructor.

property.name: MaxVertexIndex
property.summary: Gets the maximum size of indices supported for hardware vertex processing.
property.remarks: It is possible to create 32-bit index buffers; however, you will not be able to render with the index buffer unless this value is greater than 0x0000FFFF.

property.name: MaxVertexShader30InstructionSlots
property.summary: Gets the maximum number of vertex shader instruction slots supported.
property.remarks: The maximum value that can be set on this cap is 32,768. Devices that support vs_3_0 are required to support at least 512 instruction slots.

property.name: MaxVertexShaderConstants
property.summary: Gets the number of vertex shader registers that are reserved for constants.

property.name: MaxVertexShaderProfile
property.summary: Returns the maximum vertex shader profile for this GraphicsDevice.

property.name: MaxVertexW
property.summary: Gets the maximum W-based depth value that the device supports.

property.name: MaxVolumeExtent
property.summary: Gets the maximum value for any of the three dimensions (width, height, and depth) of a volume texture.

property.name: NumberOfAdaptersInGroup
property.summary: Gets the number of adapters in this adapter group (only if master).
property.remarks: NumberOfAdaptersInGroup will be 1 for conventional adapters, greater than 1 for the master adapter of a multi-head card, or 0 for a subordinate adapter of a multihead card. Each card can have at most one master, but may have many subordinates.

property.name: NumberSimultaneousRenderTargets
property.summary: Gets the number of simultaneous render targets.

property.name: PixelShader1xMaxValue
property.summary: Gets the maximum value of pixel shader arithmetic component.
property.remarks: PixelShader1xMaxValue indicates the internal range of values supported for pixel color blending operations. Within the range that they report to, implementations must allow data to pass through pixel processing unmodified (unclamped). Normally, the value of this member is an absolute value. For example, a 1.0 indicates that the range is −1.0 to 1, and an 8.0 indicates that the range is −8.0 to 8.0. The value must be greater than or equal to 1.0 for any hardware that supports pixel shaders.

property.name: PixelShaderCapabilities
property.summary: Gets the pixel shader 2.0 capabilities.

property.name: PixelShaderVersion
property.summary: Gets the pixel shader main and sub versions.

property.name: PresentInterval
property.summary: Gets the rate at which the swap chain's back buffers are presented to the front buffer.

property.name: PrimitiveCapabilities
property.summary: Gets driver primitive capabilities.

property.name: RasterCapabilities
property.summary: Gets information on raster-drawing capabilities.

property.name: ShadingCapabilities
property.summary: Gets shading operations capabilities.

property.name: SourceBlendCapabilities
property.summary: Gets source-blending capabilities.

property.name: StencilCapabilities
property.summary: Gets the supported stencil-buffer operations.

property.name: TextureAddressCapabilities
property.summary: Gets texture-addressing capabilities for texture objects.

property.name: TextureCapabilities
property.summary: Gets miscellaneous texture-mapping capabilities.

property.name: TextureFilterCapabilities
property.summary: Gets texture-filtering capabilities for a texture.
property.remarks: Per-stage filtering capabilities reflect which filtering modes are supported for texture stages when performing multiple-texture blending. This member can be any combination of the per-stage texture-filtering flags defined in GraphicsDeviceCapabilities.FilterCaps .

property.name: VertexFormatCapabilities
property.summary: Gets flexible vertex format capabilities.

property.name: VertexProcessingCapabilities
property.summary: Gets vertex processing capabilities.
property.remarks: For a given physical device, this capability might vary across Direct3D devices, depending on the parameters supplied to the Device constructor.

property.name: VertexShaderCapabilities
property.summary: Gets vertex shader version 2.0 extended capabilities.

property.name: VertexShaderVersion
property.summary: Gets the vertex shader main and sub versions.

property.name: VertexTextureFilterCapabilities
property.summary: Gets vertex shader texture filter capabilities.

property.name: VolumeTextureAddressCapabilities
property.summary: Gets texture-addressing capabilities for a volume texture

property.name: VolumeTextureFilterCapabilities
property.summary: Gets texture-filtering capabilities for a volume texture.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Releases all resources used by the GraphicsDeviceCapabilities class.

overload.summary: Releases all resources used by the GraphicsDeviceCapabilities class.
overload.remarks: Call Dispose when you are finished using the GraphicsDeviceCapabilities . The Dispose method leaves the GraphicsDeviceCapabilities in an unusable state. After calling Dispose , you must release all references to the GraphicsDeviceCapabilities so the garbage collector can reclaim the memory that the GraphicsDeviceCapabilities was occupying. Note Always call Dispose before you release your last reference to the GraphicsDeviceCapabilities . Otherwise, the resources it is using will not be freed until the garbage collector calls the GraphicsDeviceCapabilities object's Finalize method.

overload.returns: true if the objects are the same; false otherwise.
